lines.zh: 我没有脚，却仍在往前走。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet I keep moving forward.

lines.zh: 骨翼扇一下，我就前进一寸。
lines.en: One beat of bone wings carries me an inch.

lines.zh: 束缚的印子拖在身后响。
lines.en: The binding mark drags behind me with a sound.

lines.zh: 我飘过的地方，灰尘扬起。
lines.en: Dust rises where I drift past.
My master walks ahead; I follow.
My shadow is on the ground; my body is in the air.
A two-step path takes me three wingbeats.

lines.zh: 骨头碰在一起，咔咔作响。
lines.en: My bones knock together with a clatter.

lines.zh: 我被拴在那根柱子上，绕不开。
lines.en: I am tethered to that pillar and cannot circle away.

lines.zh: 风托着我，我还不太会用。
lines.en: The wind holds me up; I am still clumsy with it.

lines.zh: 我走得急，因为时间不多。
lines.en: I move quickly because my time is short.
I have walked this road only once.
I am counting what time I have left.
No order from my master, so I hang here.
Wind passes through the gaps in my bones.
I want to sit, but I have no legs.

lines.zh: 召唤的印记在胸口发烫。
lines.en: The summoning mark burns in my chest.

lines.zh: 我等着消失，也等着命令。
lines.en: I wait to vanish, and I wait for orders.
This body is not mine.

lines.zh: 我记得生前是会走路的。
lines.en: I remember walking, back when I was alive.

lines.zh: 四周太静，我听见自己响。
lines.en: It is too quiet; I hear myself rattle.
My master's incantation is not finished yet.

lines.zh: 你是主人要我找的人吗？
lines.en: Are you the one my master sent me for?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛是热的，我的不是。
lines.en: Your eyes are warm; mine are not.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，只是因为命令。
lines.en: I stare at you only because of orders.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太响，隔着空气都吵。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud even through the air.
Do not fear; I am only a pile of bones.

lines.zh: 你也在数我什么时候散架？
lines.en: Are you counting when I fall apart too?

lines.zh: 看着我，我快记不住你的脸。
lines.en: Look at me; I am forgetting your face.
My master says you must die; I am sorry.
Your shadow is more whole than mine.

lines.zh: 我认得活人，却不认得自己。
lines.en: I know the living, but not myself.
One of my ribs has snapped.
Broken bone does not hurt; it only clatters.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，本来就松。
lines.en: The spot you hit was already loose.
Half of me is scattered, and I can still fly.
A wound like this will not last to the end.
Fourteen points of life are draining away.
Stop hitting me; I am losing my shape.
My skull is crooked, and so is my sight.
I pull back to put myself together.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事，我只听见响。
lines.en: Pain is for the living; I only hear rattling.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，食物对我没用。
lines.en: I have no stomach; food does nothing for me.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我只看见骨头。
lines.en: You raise meat high; I only see bone.

lines.zh: 主人的命令比食物管用。
lines.en: My master's order works better than food.
I cannot even pronounce the word stomach.
Do not feed me; I cannot swallow.

lines.zh: 那点香气穿过了我的肋骨。
lines.en: That smell passes straight through my ribs.
The only thing I want is an order.

lines.zh: 你把东西收起来，省点力气。
lines.en: Put that away and save your strength.
Bones do not eat; they only rattle.

lines.zh: 留着你的粮食，我用不上。
lines.en: Keep your grain; I have no use for it.
Bump into me and you hurt more than I do.
I am as light as a bundle of firewood.
You passed right through my shoulder blade.
Do not push; one push and I scatter.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨卡在你盔甲上。
lines.en: My ribs catch on your armor.
That bump cost me a finger bone.
I drift; you cannot hit me squarely.
Move; my master is calling me back.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在我头骨里回响。
lines.en: The knock echoes inside my skull.
You knocked me apart; now I must reassemble.
How does a skeleton breed?

lines.zh: 皮肉先走了，血也没留下。
lines.en: The flesh went first, and the blood stayed behind.

lines.zh: 主人没给过我这种命令。
lines.en: My master never gave me such an order.

lines.zh: 同类的骨头都埋在土里。
lines.en: The bones of my kind are all in the ground.

lines.zh: 别问了，我也想知道我是谁。
lines.en: Do not ask; I want to know who I am too.

lines.zh: 这具身体只借我一小会儿。
lines.en: This body is lent to me only briefly.
No partner, only a summoner.
My name was given by someone else.
When the time ends, I am gone.

lines.zh: 结伴要有以后，我没有以后。
lines.en: Companions need a future; I have none.
My hands cannot grip anything.
My finger bones are too loose to pick things up.

lines.zh: 地上那枚箭头，我用不上。
lines.en: That arrowhead on the ground is useless to me.

lines.zh: 倒下的时候，我什么都不掉。
lines.en: When I fall, I drop nothing at all.
My master forbids me to touch the spoils.

lines.zh: 捡了也带不走，时间不够。
lines.en: I could not carry it; there is no time.
If I bend, my neck bone creaks.
Let the living pick it up.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过了我的指缝。
lines.en: It slips straight through my fingers.
I do not collect; I only disappear.
My master points at you; I am coming.
Fourteen points of life, enough for one charge.
You were named; do not blame the bones.

lines.zh: 你的胸口在起伏，我看见了。
lines.en: Your chest rises and falls; I see it.
The order falls, and I turn toward you.
Do not run; I fly faster than you.

lines.zh: 这一趟，我只有一次机会。
lines.en: I get only one chance at this.
The binding loosens; I can move now.

lines.zh: 你正好站在召唤点的圈里。
lines.en: You happen to stand inside the summoning ring.
Five points of force, aimed at the soft spots.
I charge straight, without turning.

lines.zh: 胸口印子亮了，目标是你。
lines.en: The mark on my chest glows; the target is you.
You are standing in my master's way.

lines.zh: 主人要你，我就把你带来。
lines.en: My master wants you, so I will bring you.
That tether pulls me toward you.

lines.zh: 我数了数，你只有一个人。
lines.en: I counted; you are alone.
My bones carry my master's order.
I hover overhead and tighten the circle.

lines.zh: 你在下面跑，我在上面跟。
lines.en: You run below; I follow above.
My shadow falls at your feet.
Do not look up; if you do, I am already there.

lines.zh: 你的后背空着，我看见了。
lines.en: Your back is open; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我数你的步子，你快没劲了。
lines.en: I count your steps; you are tiring.
Three wingbeats, then I dive.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，正好方便我。
lines.en: You back to the wall; that suits me.

lines.zh: 这圈地是我的界限，别出去。
lines.en: This ring is my boundary; do not leave it.
I do not tire; bones do not tire.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得出。
lines.en: Your breathing is ragged; I can hear it.
Two more steps and I strike.
I chase you along the treetops.

lines.zh: 别躲门后，门挡不住骨头。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the door; it will not stop bone.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，擦着你的肩过去。
lines.en: I drop low and skim past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在你面前散开又聚起。
lines.en: My bones scatter before you and reassemble.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就绕到盾后面。
lines.en: You raise the shield; I go behind it.
I hold above your head for a moment.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的翅膀响一下。
lines.en: You step back; my wings clatter once.

lines.zh: 我斜着切过去，骨头先到。
lines.en: I cut in at an angle, bones arriving first.
Bone strikes your side ribs.
This blow will please my master.

lines.zh: 我的掌骨拍在你护腕上。
lines.en: My palm bone slaps your bracer.
All five points of force, spent at once.
You retreat two steps; I advance one.

lines.zh: 撞击声从我这边传到你那边。
lines.en: The impact travels from my side to yours.

lines.zh: 我撞你的时候，自己也在碎。
lines.en: When I hit you, I break too.
Do not cover up; the next hit is coming.
A finger bone stays in your armor's gap.

lines.zh: 我冲撞的姿势不好看，但有用。
lines.en: My charge looks clumsy, but it works.
Count this one as duty done.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡了一下，我绕开。
lines.en: Your shield blocks once; I come around it.
Bone presses you, and you give ground.
I will fall apart after this; do not rush.
My spine strikes your lower back.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我自己撞散了一节。
lines.en: The impact shakes a rib loose from me.

lines.zh: 黑色的印记亮起，我成形了。
lines.en: The black mark glows, and I take shape.

lines.zh: 主人一开口，我从地里立起来。
lines.en: My master speaks, and I rise from the ground.
The bones arrive first; there is no flesh.
I open my eyes, and the sockets are empty.

lines.zh: 召唤点在地上，我绕不过去。
lines.en: The summoning point is on the ground; I cannot leave it.

lines.zh: 又一次，我从咒语里被拉出来。
lines.en: Again I am pulled out of an incantation.
Fourteen points of life, just barely enough.

lines.zh: 我落地时几乎没有重量。
lines.en: I land with almost no weight at all.

lines.zh: 主人的手指向哪，我就在哪。
lines.en: Where my master points, there I stand.
The first word I hear is: go.
This skeleton was assembled on the spot.
The wind sways me for a moment.

lines.zh: 地上的灰聚成人形，那就是我。
lines.en: Dust gathers into a shape, and that is me.
I am woken again, for the third time.

lines.zh: 我的骨头烧黑了，还是很轻。
lines.en: My bones are scorched black, and still light.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，摔成两截。
lines.en: I fell from above and broke in two.

lines.zh: 水灌满胸腔，我却沉不下去。
lines.en: Water fills my ribcage, yet I will not sink.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我吹散了。
lines.en: The blast wave blows me apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肋骨，钉在后面的树上。
lines.en: The arrow passes my ribs and sticks in a tree.

lines.zh: 咒语打在骨头上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: The spell hits bone and raises white smoke.
I have no stomach, so hunger cannot touch me.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的骨头亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my bones flash bright.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有召唤点，我回不去。
lines.en: No summoning point in the void; I cannot return.
